newsitem.title: UK: European Diary for Advertising & Media - to May 23.
newsitem.headline: European Diary for Advertising & Media - to May 23.

text.p: REUTERS EUROPEAN DIARY OF EVENTS FOR ADVERTISING & MEDIA - to May 23
The following is a four-week diary of events covering advertising, marketing, media and the Internet in Europe.
TUESDAY, MAY 6

LONDON - Launch of Advertising Association's publication "Does Advertising Affect Market Size?" at IPA, 44 Belgrave Square, London SW1. Contact: Arabella Price (44) 171 828 2771, fax (44) 171 931 0376, email advert@dial.pipex.com.
THURSDAY, MAY 8
LONDON - Talking to Women '97, conference on marketing to women.
Sponsored by UK's Channel 4. Contact: (44) 171 306 8232.
WEDNESDAY, MAY 14
MUNICH - Advertising Summit, featuring top German media officials, ad agency managers and marketers. Hotel Park Hilton.
(first day of two-day conference)

THURSDAY, MAY 15 LONDON - Digital and the Future of Radio & Audio: Where Next for Audio & Radio Data Services? Cafe Royal. Contact: (44) 171 453 2700 or (44) 171 637 4383. (first day of two-day conference) MUNICH - Advertising Summit, featuring top German media officials, ad agency managers and marketers. Hotel Park Hilton.
(second day of two-day conference)
FRIDAY, MAY 16
LONDON - Digital and the Future of Radio & Audio: Where Next for Audio & Radio Data Services? Cafe Royal. (second day of two-day conference)
MONDAY, MAY 19
LONDON - Marjorie Scardino, chief executive of Pearson Plc, addresses Advertising Association's Annual General Meeting luncheon. Savoy Hotel. Contact: Arabella Price (44) 171 828 2771
TUESDAY, MAY 20
LONDON - Internet World UK-Spring 97, National Hall and Conference Centre, Olympia. Contact: (44) 1865 388000 or www.iwuk.com (first day of three-day conference)
LONDON - A New Century in Publishing, Financial Times Conference. Contact: (44) 171 896 2626. (first day of two-day conference)
LONDON - The Creative Show conference, Business Design Centre, Islington, London N1. Contact: (44) 171 287 5678, fax (44) 171 287 0710. (first day of three-day conference)
WEDNESDAY, MAY 21
LONDON - Internet World UK-Spring 97, (second day of three-day conference)
LONDON - A New Century in Publishing, Financial Times Conference. (second day of two-day conference)
LONDON - Youth Perspective 2, annual youth marketing conference.
0830 -1600 GMT, Ministry of Sound, London SE1. Contact: (44) 171 413 4486
LONDON - The Creative Show conference, Business Design Centre, Islington, London N1 (second day of three-day conference)
THURSDAY, MAY 22
LONDON - Internet World UK-Spring 97 (final day of three-day conference)
LONDON - The European Strategy Summit: Digital Terrestrial Television. Marriott Hotel, Grosvenor Square. Contact: (44) 171 453 2700. (first day of two-day conference)
LONDON - Intranets: Key Issues for the Employee Communicator.
